scope: Proposition 5.2 (Measurable local labels) of the manuscript “Rokhlin's multiple-mixing problem for one transformation” (preprints/Rokhlins-multiple-mixing-problem-for-one-transformation-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 145 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 45000cec6bcec95d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 25. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a measurable countable family of abelian groups u 7→ L(u), defined on a ν-conull set, with the following properties. 1. Each ℓ ∈ L(u) labels a line in Hu with a measurable modulus-one representative χu,ℓ. The iden- tity label 0 has representative 1. Distinct labels are orthogonal, every nonidentity representative has mean zero, and χu,ℓχu,ℓ′ ∈ Tχu,ℓ+ℓ′ . 2. For π-almost every p, the exact lines at slot i of λp are precisely L(pi), for every i, and they span its active space. Unique exact matching gives measurable group isomorphisms Φst(p) : L(ps) −→ L(pt) (s, t ∈ I), where Φss(p) = id. 3. Local time gives measurable group isomorphisms τu : L(u) −→ L(TU u), [χ] 7−→ [χ ◦ T−1 Y ]. They respect exact matching. All local time assertions may be imposed on an invariant conull set. 4. For ϑ-almost every parameter square, prescribing a label at any one cell gives a unique array of labels matched along every row and every column.
